_about: Factions a player can pick in the pass-and-play Duel. deck = [decks.json key, 'player'|'enemy']. empire is the rules empire (its passive applies). ground is the battlefield painting. Add a faction here to add it to the picker.

factions.name: Maurya
factions.blurb: Chakravartin's army: cheap Kosha, pikes, elephants and spies.

factions.name: Gupta
factions.blurb: The Golden Age: Mantras that draw cards, cavalry and learning.

factions.name: Chalukya
factions.blurb: Stone forts: a 28 Durg and stronger Raksha guards.

factions.name: Chola
factions.blurb: The Tiger Banner: ranged units hit harder, fleets and elephants.

factions.name: Rajput
factions.blurb: Vega riders that arrive stronger, fort guards and clan foot.

factions.name: Ghurid
factions.blurb: Horse archers, heavy reserve and the war-drums.

factions.name: Nanda
factions.blurb: The rich old throne of Magadha: gold, elephants, chariots.

factions.name: Seleucid
factions.blurb: Pike phalanx, Greek cavalry and siege engines.

factions.name: Naga kings
factions.blurb: The Naga kings of the north: poison, serpents and cunning.

factions.name: Forest kingdoms
factions.blurb: Mahakantara: ambush, archers and the green jungle.

factions.name: Pallava of Kanchi
factions.blurb: Walled Kanchi: a gate line and the Pallava king.

factions.name: Western Kshatrapas
factions.blurb: The Satraps of the west: horse archers and silver coin.

factions.name: Vardhana
factions.blurb: Harsha's great host of elephants and foot.

factions.name: Pala
factions.blurb: The Pala empire of Bengal: war elephants on the Ganga.

factions.name: Srivijaya
factions.blurb: The sea kings: a boat wall and fire boats.

factions.name: Anuradhapura
factions.blurb: The island kingdom: elephants, archers and monks.
